study.question: After the r0075 duplicate early/late control failed its parity criterion, can sharing identical affine tower rows preserve the intended native normalization measure, establish null parity, and yield an interpretable recheck of local coarse-sign averaging location?
study.hypothesis: The algebraically identical duplicate readouts in r0075 acquired different optimization trajectories through redundant BF16 affine/gradient graphs or other unverified execution variability. Coalescing affine representatives while retaining native4B Dice populations will provide a structurally shared null computation. Conditional on fixed-state native equivalence and null parity, the reflected early/late contrast can be reassessed. This is a testable execution hypothesis, not an established explanation; late averaging need not improve AUC.
